description: Read the current tab's console messages and uncaught page errors (the last 200, kept from when SynaBun opened the tab), localhost pages included. Use level "error" to check a page for errors, and clear or since to see only what a reload or an action produced.

clear.description: Empty the tab's buffer after reading, so the next call shows only new entries.

level.description: Lowest level to return; each level includes the more severe ones (error < warning < info < log). Default "all". Uncaught page errors count as errors.

limit.description: Return at most this many of the newest matching entries (default 50).

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

since.description: Only entries after this time (ISO timestamp or epoch ms), e.g. the "latest" value of a previous call.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_console
